facts.label: Bank
facts.prompt: Which bank does the person use?
facts.placeholder: such as ANZ - or two, as ANZ, Kiwibank

facts.label: Expecting a parcel
facts.prompt: Is the person expecting a parcel or a delivery?

options.text: Yes, something is on its way
No, nothing is on its way

questions.prompt: Which bank does the caller say they are calling from?
questions.hint: The person banks with {bank}. Choose {bank} only when the caller names it. A different bank, or a card or payment company calling about another bank's account, is a bank that is not {bank}.

questions.prompt: Does the caller ask the person to pay a charge, or to give card or personal details, before a parcel can be delivered?

options.text: Yes: a charge, or details, before delivery

rules.label: scam
rules.why: {name} banks with {bank}. Another bank holds no account of theirs to protect, fix or check.
rules.advice: Hang up. If you are worried about your money, call {bank} on the number on your card.

rules.label: scam
rules.why: {name} is not expecting a parcel, so a charge or details to release one cannot be for anything of theirs.
rules.advice: Don't pay and don't give details. If you did order something, check with the shop you ordered from.
